decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program extends the firm's core psychiatric treatment competence, so its specialist teams can interpret utilization data and refine the program within the existing clinical structure.
Custom furniture carpentry builds on established sheltered-workshop production and therapy know-how, letting the firm absorb customer feedback and adjust the offer at modest cost.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm's mental health and outpatient expertise, so it can learn from early cases, though its low web visibility suggests lower priority.
Senior living counseling draws directly on the firm's eldercare knowledge, is cheap to run, and serves as an entry point to its other services.
The retail shop sells the sheltered workshop's existing products, but retail lies further from the firm's care knowledge, so it carries somewhat higher risk while still being worth keeping.
Senior meal delivery fits the firm's eldercare and everyday-life assistance know-how and its kitchen or production capacities, so the firm can read early demand and adapt the service.
